name: apex-skill-forge-v9-universal
description: Production skill engineering system that forges, audits, and packages agent skills with measured trigger accuracy, hard token budgets, and a marketplace-ready distribution pack.
author: APEX Business Systems Ltd.

platforms: any agent supporting the open Agent Skills format (SKILL.md)

install.generic_agent: copy this folder into the agent's skills directory (e.g. ~/.claude/skills/, project skill folders, or equivalent)
install.no_execution_runtime: paste SKILL.md into the model's context; apply references/universal-protocol.md manually
